svg.title: Receptive fields: from local strokes to whole images
svg.desc: A fully vector illustration of the EMNIST ConvVAE. The h2 and h3 panels show all 25 input-field centres, shaded by the corresponding weights of the selected 5x5 kernel. Only the top-left receptive field has a green outline. Dataset images and gradient heatmaps are vector pixel cells; 3D surfaces are cubic interpolations of the measured gradient samples. No bitmap is embedded.
